Name: Alex's Ice Cream Stand Sells A Few More Items
Author: ketchupchappie
Description:
[size=5]Cheaper Ice Creams, Granny Evelyn's Cookies, and more![/size]

This mod adds new selling items to Alex's Ice Cream Stand.
In addition to ice creams, you can buy cookies, field snacks, ginger ales, eggs,  and Mayonnaises for less than the normal price.
Also, add items by day of the week, by season, and for special days (E.g. Alex's birthday, Evelyn's birthday, etc. ).

If you have installed a mod which enables you to access the Ice Cream Stand outside of summer (the shop opening season of the Vanilla game ), you can buy seasonal items in spring, autumn, and winter.
